In this episode of First Cut, Dabeet Singh reviews Chand Mera Dil, directed by Vivek Soni and produced by Dharma Productions.
The film follows college sweethearts Aarav and Chandni as their carefree romance slowly collides with adulthood, responsibility, and emotional compromises. What begins as a breezy campus love story gradually turns into a dramatic relationship saga about evolving priorities and whether first love can survive the real world.
